name: Arwic
summary: Arwic lies between the hills south of the Lost Wish Mountains; once a mining and trading village, it was destroyed by Shadow Spires in the Fourth Sending of Darkness and rebuilt as a fortified city ringed by sturdy stone walls, with Aun Laokhe (translator of Burun writings) at the top of its central tower. In the world it is a compact 120 x 86 m walled square on flat grassland (z 42): four three-story corner towers (top 61.6), spire-roofed gatehouses on the west and south gates, an inner cross-wall, a four-story central tower with a tapered roof (top 72.9), a narrow plaza with the Town Network portal, a silver fountain and the Life Stone, and ruined pillar avenues of 10 m stone posts leading in from the west and the south.

landmarks.name: West gate and spired gatehouses S76/S77
landmarks.note: Spire roofs top 57.1; ruined pillar avenue on its axis.

landmarks.name: Silver fountain
landmarks.note: Water fountain (setup 0x02000AA3) at the foot of the central tower.

landmarks.name: Western pillar avenue
landmarks.note: Two rows of 10 m stone posts with metal lintels (y 32514/32526).

shots.standingOrder: Hang straight above the walled square of Arwic and rotate slowly so its walls, towers and courtyards turn like a map; hold height 30 m above the central tower.
shots.notes: Map shot: hangs 105 m above the walled square (z 147, 74 m above the central tower) looking straight down and rotating 45 deg; the 120 x 86 m wall ring, four corner towers, two spired gates, the inner cross-wall and the plaza fit the frame (corner towers at NDC +/-0.7). Late-afternoon sun from the west adds long tower shadows.

shots.standingOrder: Truck south along the sunlit west wall of Arwic past the gate and its spired gatehouses, 13 m off the stone and 2.5 m up; nothing may come between lens and wall.
shots.notes: The town's facade pan (fortress walls): trucks 32 m south along the sunlit west wall at 2.2 m above the grass, 11-13 m off the stone, past the spired gatehouses and through the axis of the ruined pillar avenue (pillars 7.6 m from the lens). Sun at the camera's back fully lights the wall. Clearance: nearest pillar 7.6 m, wall 11 m, query-radius 4 m = 0 statics; vmax 4.2 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Fly fast and level east along the north side of the walls, whipping past the north-west corner tower 12 m off its stones; climb rather than swerve if anything comes within 6 m.
shots.notes: Energetic fly-by: 10 m/s level pass east along the outside of the north wall, 13 m above the grass, whipping past the NW corner tower at 12 m offset (peak yaw ~0.8 rad/s). Clearance: 17 m to the tower box, nothing else within 28 m.

shots.standingOrder: Look down the plaza from above the Life Stone onto the swirling Town Network portal and the silver fountain beside the central tower, easing 3 m closer; stay 5 m above the roofs.
shots.notes: Particle + water detail: high angle (34 deg) from above the Life Stone looking down the plaza onto the swirling Town Network portal (NDC 0.03,-0.5) with the silver fountain just beyond it (NDC -0.04,0.09) and the central tower's foot at left, easing 3 m closer. Camera 16-18 m above the plaza, 9 m from the nearest roof edge (S68 top 54.5).

shots.standingOrder: Fly straight back from the central tower over the south wall while zooming in so the tower holds its size and the hills swell behind it; stay 12 m above the walls.
shots.notes: Vertigo closer: flies straight back from the central tower (Aun Laokhe's tower, top 72.9) 45->120 m SSW at 26 m above the plain while zooming 55->23 deg so the tower holds its size and the Lost Wish hills swell behind it. Clearance: 11 m above the south gatehouse spire (top 57.1), 14 m above the southern pillar avenue; vmax 7.9 m/s.
